-73.97150,40.74600.name: NYU Langone Fertility Center
-73.97150,40.74600.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: James A. Grifo, MD, PHD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.14828,51.52250.name: Harley Street Fertility Clinic
-0.14828,51.52250.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-84.55463,42.73383.name: Emergent BioDefense Operations Lansing, LLC
-84.55463,42.73383.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Emergent BioSolutions Inc.. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

31.23570,30.04440.name: Agricultural Genetic Engineering Research Institute
31.23570,30.04440.desc: Egypt’s public genetic engineering institute, in a country that has approved and then suspended engineered maize cultivation. Egypt is the largest wheat importer in the world, which makes its position on engineered grain consequential well beyond its own fields.

31.23570,30.04440.name: Egypt — wheat import tenders and GM specification
31.23570,30.04440.desc: The largest wheat importer in the world, buying through state tenders whose specifications set terms for exporters across several continents. Egypt has at times specified GM-free consignments and at times abandoned the requirement under supply pressure, and each shift moves what traders segregate. A tender document from one buyer of this size functions as regulation for everyone selling into it.

3.94700,7.37750.name: NACGRAB — National Centre for Genetic Resources and Biotechnology
3.94700,7.37750.state: Ibadan — National Centre for Genetic Resources and Biotechnology
3.94700,7.37750.desc: Nigeria's genetic resources and biotechnology centre, which is where the national variety release committee meets and where TELA maize was formally announced for release. Variety registration is the step between a biosafety clearance and a bag of seed a farmer can buy, and it is run by a different body from the one that assessed the risk. Where a country's engineered varieties are actually named and numbered is the register worth having.
